name: Base-N Objective Substitution
description: Replaced the explicit "lexicographically smallest" tie-break rule with an equivalent algebraic objective function (sum of c_i * 4^{n-i}). This forces models to recognize that the objective is strictly minimized by the lexicographically first sequence. Models that merely pattern-match will likely attempt a full state-space search to minimize the function and Time Out, whereas models that reason structurally will deduce the equivalence and use an early-exit DFS.
